title: Listen and Choose a Response — Library

questions.stem: Could I borrow your phone charger for a few minutes?

options.A: Sure, but I'll need it back before I leave.
options.B: I charged my phone last night.
options.C: The library closes in an hour.
options.D: Yes, I borrowed it from my brother.

questions.explanation: Agreeing with a condition is a natural response to a request; the tense-shifted option refers to a different action.
